facts.business: AGI Infra Limited is a real estate development company engaged in the construction and sale of residential and commercial properties, primarily in Punjab, using technologies like MIVAN aluminium formwork.

capacity_or_capex.item: Investment in Construction of ongoing projects

guidance_or_targets.statement: Pipeline of approximately 7.9 million square feet scheduled for launch in the near future

key_risks: Revenue recognition timing and control transfer
Inventory valuation complexities across multiple locations and work-in-progress stages
Trade receivables ageing and customer repayment ability
Disputed Service Tax liability of Rs 9.69 crore for 2012-13 to 2016-17 pending at CESTAT
Properties not held in company's name (held by Managing Director and related party)
facts.related_party_note: Property at G.T. Road adjoining Kosmo Tata in village Barring (121.5 Marlas) with gross carrying value of Rs 869.72 Lakhs is held in the name of AGI Hospitalities Private Limited, a related party. Property at 184 New Jawahar Nagar, Jalandhar (portion of project 'AGI PRIDE') with gross carrying value of Rs 1240 Lakhs is held in the name of Managing Director S. Sukhdev Singh.
